name: Popconfirm
usage: Removing a member, revoking access, deleting a draft row

props.name: title
props.description: The question, such as "Remove this member?".

props.name: description
props.description: Explanation below the question: what will happen.

props.name: okText
props.description: Text of the confirm button; the built-in text ("OK") by default.

props.name: okTone
props.description: Semantic color of the confirm button: `danger` for destructive actions.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description:
Called when the user confirms. When it returns a promise, the confirm button shows a loading indicator and the
popup stays open until the promise settles.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when the user cancels with the Cancel button.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger: one element that accepts events and a ref, usually a Button or a LinkButton.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: For actions with a small impact that still need confirmation; irreversible deletions use useConfirmDanger.
